text:
mira: Heads-up: ops wants to sweep `prefix_cache_ttl` 30->300 to reduce KV churn. Need safe rollout plan + console visibility. Any immediate objections?
alex: Risk = per-shard memory increase and GC/eviction behavior. Need mem-delta estimate and p99 impact for small models.
jess: Console ask: can we tag this as a 'sweep' so the UI treats it differently from targeted flags? Propose optional `rollout_type` on apply API.
tyler: We already have `purpose` metadata. Fine to add but minimize new surface area and keep backwards compat.
sam: Rollout proposal: 1) staging replay 24h, 2) 1% tenant-cohort (by tenant_id) for 2h, 3) 10% for 6h if gates pass, 4) full sweep. Gates: >=5k sampled reqs, <2% increase in quota_rejects, <5% per-shard mem bump, p99 latency delta <10ms.
ops-bot: Created alert `prefix-cache-mem-80pct` -> Pager after 10m (ID ACL-3742).
alex: Need per-tenant cache size + delta in Console for triage; console shows only global mem today.
jess: I can own Console once API exposes data. Proposed API additions: optional enum `rollout_type`: ["targeted","sweep","dry-run"], plus optional `previous_version` and `applied_by` audit fields. Non-breaking.
mira: Revert story: last time rollback was messy. Option A: return `rollback_token` on apply. Option B: bump `config_version` atomically and retain previous version for 10m so controller can set it back. Prefer smaller API.
tyler: I prefer config_version approach; avoids extra token.
sam: Telemetry gating: wait a warm window of 30m after cohort start before computing deltas to avoid transient noise; also require min sample threshold. I'll draft PromQL.
alex: Ops playbook dry-run example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/configs/apply \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_API" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"config_key":"prefix_cache_ttl","value":300,"dry_run":true,"meta":{"rollout_type":"dry-run","operator":"mira"}}'
```
jess: Console: dry-run entries orange with hover "no traffic change - dry run"; sweeps get distinct badge + runbook link.
mira: Actions: sam run staging replay and post mem estimates by EOD; jess open API extension PR; alex+tyler prototype per-tenant mem panel (use aggregated samples if necessary); ops wire alert into canary.
ops-bot: Runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/prefix-cache-sweep
sam: Draft PromQL for eviction ratio delta (baseline vs cohort): `increase(prefix_cache_evictions_total[5m]) / increase(prefix_cache_hits_total[5m])` filtered by cohort label. Will refine after replay.
alex: If staging numbers look safe we can start 1% cohort tomorrow morning.
mira: Thanks everyone. Ping here if blocked. :thumbsup:
